Message.Name: Refresh Request Message
Message.Description: Client-to-server request to refresh all market state. Server responds with Refresh Response (1202) followed by the snapshot messages, terminated by Refresh Complete (203).

Message.Name: Refresh Response Message
Message.Description: Server acknowledgement of a client Refresh Request.

Message.Name: Refresh Complete Message
Message.Description: Published at the end of a refresh cycle. Once received, the client is up to date and will resume receiving normal data flow.

Field.Name: LastInternalSeqNum
Field.Description: The internal sequence number with this refresh (matches the Message Header InternalSeqNum).
